PROPELLER SHAFT — Propeller Shaft

PR-7

5. INSTALL SPIDER BEARINGS

(a) Apply MP grease to the spider and bearings.
HINT: Be careful not to apply too much grease.

PR0024 PR0025

(b) Align the matchmarks on the yoke and shaft.

PR0026

(c) Fit a new spider into the yoke.
(d) Using SST, install new bearings on the spider.
SST 09332-25010

PR0027

(e) Using SST, adjust both bearings so that the snap ring grooves are at maximum and equal widths.

PR0028

6. INSTALL SNAP RINGS

(a) Install two snap rings of equal thickness which will allow 0 — 0.05 mm (0 — 0.0020 in.) axial play.

HINT: Do not reuse the snap rings.
